css: .r45-challan { font-size: 12px; } .r45-challan table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; } .r45-challan th, .r45-challan td { border: 1px solid #444; padding: 4px 6px; } .r45-challan .no-border td { border: none; padding: 2px 0; } .r45-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 8px; } .r45-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase; } .r45-decl { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 11px; } .r45-sign { margin-top: 40px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
